text:
Release verdict written to REVIEW.md. 

**Verified:** The invoice list feature meets MVP functional scope (sign-in, list own invoices, sign-out) and data isolation at the backend level. However, **three critical security gaps block release**: (1) no actual authentication—the sign-in endpoint accepts any staffId without verification, allowing impersonation; (2) trivial default session secret ('change-me'); (3) hardcoded credential-like strings in client code. While backend logic correctly filters invoices per staffId, the missing authentication layer means any user can assume any staff identity, defeating that isolation entirely.
